title: A bare SUM in a calculated column gives the grand total on every row

source.quote: The first calculated column returns the grand total of Sales[Quantity], because no filter context is active
source.supports: a calculated column in Product defined as SUM ( Sales[Quantity] ) returns the grand total, as there is only a row context

derivation: A calculated column has a row context and no filter context, and there is no CALCULATE. SUM ( Sales[Quantity] ) is 1 + 2 + 1 + 5 + 2 + 3 + 1 = 15 on each of the 4 product rows.
